name: frontend-spec-plugin
description: Collects missing PRD, prototype, and API inputs before turning a frontend feature request into an implementation-ready specification.

interface.longDescription: A frontend-focused specification pipeline for requests to add, create, design, or develop a frontend feature. It first asks for any missing PRD or requirement, UI prototype, and API contract, then structures requirements, resolves ambiguities, maps UI and APIs, and produces an implementation-ready specification without scanning the surrounding project or generating application code.
defaultPrompt: Add a frontend feature. First ask me for any missing PRD, prototype, and API inputs.
Design this frontend feature and collect the required specification inputs from me first.
Turn my requirement, UI prototype, and API contract into a frontend specification.
